entries.text: The lane runtime is opencode v2.0.27 on PATH, and V2-first holds: V2 claims are authoritative for this lane.
The OpenCode V2 runtime auto-loads AGENTS.md and that file alone: not the generated mirror, not AGENT.md, and not the accepted-but-inert instructions array.

task-dispatcher registers from the plugin module setup surface against the session prompt hook, appends its instruction to event.prompt.text after a blank line, returns early on an empty draft, and appends at the end so attachment mention offsets survive by construction.

The dispatcher kill switch is taskDispatcher.enabled in .opencode/arsenal.json defaulting to true; the config root resolves from ctx.location.directory with the working directory as fallback, and setting it false stops the injection and nothing else.

V1 native theming is a flat defs plus theme map selected via tui.json or the theme command with ANSI values and none inheritance, while V2 native theming is base plus light and dark hue palettes with overrides selected via cli.json or the themes command with transparent and dollar-references; both examples reuse the literal schema URL, so the URL alone never distinguishes versions and only the top-level keys do.

The declared V2 session hook names are prompt, context, compaction, generate, title, model.request, http.request, http.response, experimental.ws.handshake, experimental.ws.send, experimental.ws.receive, and retry; there is no agent-switch, session-start, or theme hook, while the agent string stays observable per model call and CLI plugins read context.theme read-only.
